episodes.title: Whole Lotta Love
episodes.summary: Eager to move on with his new girlfriend, Jack wants a clean break from his wife Betty — but she demands the one thing he'll never give up: The Jackal.

episodes.title: Carpe Vitam
episodes.summary: As Jack struggles to find a new cannabis supplier, Marjolein takes him along to the Amsterdam Music Awards, where Betty has a nasty surprise in store.

episodes.title: Forever, Pour Toujours
episodes.summary: Thrust back into the spotlight after her encounter with Marjolein, Betty decides to air Jack's dirty laundry during a talk show appearance.

episodes.title: We Cheer You Up In The Pin-Up Club
episodes.summary: When Jack and Betty both need to win over Bolle, one of The Jackal's shareholders, he plays them against each other with an unusual challenge.

episodes.title: Til Death Do Us Part
episodes.summary: Tempers flare and allegiances shift as the fight for The Jackal enters the courtroom. Betty's desperate deal with the Tichelaars puts Jack in danger.

episodes.title: Daddy Issues
episodes.summary: With Jack out of commission, Betty is left to face the Tichelaars alone. Katya is forced to confront not just who her father is, but who she wants to be.

episodes.title: Fire
episodes.summary: With her enemies closing in and The Jackal slipping away, Betty ends up back where she started — but with one more card to play. Will it be enough?
